## Files to change

**Worker (mirror the `shop.ts` pattern — deterministic endpoint, not AI-narrated, so HP/gold math is exact):**

1. **`worker/src/types/index.ts`** — add `InnRestBody { sessionId, characterId, innId? }` interface, and a cost constant/field (e.g. `INN_REST_COST = 10` or add `cost_per_rest` to an inn-type row).

2. **`worker/migrations/000X_add_inns.sql`** (new) — add an `inns` table (`id, name, location, cost_per_rest`) if inn pricing should vary by location, similar to `shops`/`shop_inventory`. (Optional — can skip and hardcode a flat/formula cost instead.)

3. **`worker/src/routes/inn.ts`** (new) — Hono route, e.g. `POST /api/inn/rest`: load character via `getCharacter`, compute cost (flat value or e.g. `5 * missing HP`), check `character.gold >= cost`, then `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: character.max_hp, gold: character.gold - cost })`, return updated character. Pattern copied from `shopRoutes.post('/transaction')`.

4. **`worker/src/index.ts`** — import `innRoutes` and register `app.route('/api/inn', innRoutes)`.

5. **`worker/src/services/character.ts`** — no change needed (`updateCharacter` already supports `hp`/`gold`); optionally add a `restAtInn()` helper for reuse.

**Angular frontend:**

6. **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`** — add `restAtInn(body: { sessionId, characterId, innId? }): Observable<{ success: boolean; updatedCharacter: Character }>` posting to `${API_BASE}/api/inn/rest` (mirrors `shopTransaction`).

7. **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`** — no new model required (reuses `Character`); add `InnRestResponse` type if desired.

8. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`** — add `restAtInn()` method calling `api.restAtInn(...)`, then `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` and `pushEntry('system', ...)`.

9. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html`** — add a "Rest at the Inn" button (disable when `charSvc.character()?.gold < cost` or HP already full) wired to `restAtInn()`.

10. **`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`** — no change needed (`setCharacter`/`hpPercent` already derive from `hp`/`max_hp`).
